name: Capital One Savor Rewards for Good Credit

welcome_offer.description: You’ll earn the usual Savor grocery store, dining and entertainment rewards, but won’t be eligible for new cardmember bonus cash or 0% intro APR

earning_rates.notes: Tickets purchased through the Capital One Entertainment ticketing platform; excludes Capital One cardholder exclusive presales and tickets purchased directly through Capital One Hall or Capital One Arena ticketing services.
Hotels, vacation rentals and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel.
Unlimited cash back on dining; merchant category codes determine eligibility.

Unlimited cash back at grocery stores; excludes gas stations, convenience stores, warehouse clubs, discount stores and superstores (including grocery stores associated with discount stores or superstores), which earn 1%.
Unlimited cash back on qualified entertainment purchases; third-party sites and vendors without qualifying entertainment merchant category codes earn 1%.
Unlimited cash back on popular streaming services.
Unlimited cash back on all other purchases. Earnings apply to net purchases (purchases minus credits or returns).
